statement: ∀ r q : ℕ, r.Prime → q.Prime → r ≠ q → (r*q).divisors.sum (fun d => -(ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℝ)*Real.log d) = 0

plain_statement.en: New route · Short and long divisors · TP-0037 · Compute exact Möbius cancellation at a product of distinct primes
